subject: Re: Redwood + StellarApps - Post-demo next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Michael Thompson <michael@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood + StellarApps — Post-demo recap and next steps

Hi Michael — great to meet with you and the engineering team this morning.

Quick recap from our demo and the items we agreed to follow up on:  \
- Demo highlights: low-latency embeddings for search, model routing for cost optimization, and Redwood Console observability for per-route latency/cost.
- Action: I’ll send the tailored demo deck and a draft mutual action plan (MAP) + MOP (memorandum of performance) that outlines integration milestones.
- Technical follow-up: your engineers requested the model quantization profiles and expected throughput numbers for a ~250 req/s workload — Aditya will include those.
- Commercial: you said the budget round and procurement approvals are targeted for end of quarter (EoQ). If that timing shifts, please let us know so we can prioritize a pricing window.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (deck), draft-mop-v1.docx (integration milestones) — attached for your review.

Proposed next steps:  \
1) Aditya to send throughput/quant tables by EOD Wed.
2) Michael/engineering to confirm any remaining integration questions by next Tue so we can prepare a POC plan.
3) Align on procurement timeline so I can reserve Dedicated capacity for your EoQ window if you decide to move forward.

Does that look right on your end? Happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Michael Thompson <michael@stellarapps.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:03:20 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood + StellarApps — Post-demo recap and next steps

Hi Michael — just bumping this ahead of EoQ.  \

Quick check: is the budget/approval timeline still on track for this quarter? We want to make sure we can honor the pricing and hold capacity for StellarApps if you’re still planning to move forward. If priorities shifted, totally understand — if so, can you share the new timing?

If it’s helpful, we can also set a 20-min sync with procurement this week to walk through our procurement checklist and DocuSign flow so your SOW and PO lines up with your EoQ close.

Thanks — appreciate a quick note either way.

Best,
Lauren
--

Hi Lauren — thanks for the follow-up and the deck. Apologies for the delay — procurement has been juggling a couple of last-minute items.

Short answer: still planning to close this quarter, budget is approved pending final SOW & PO lines. We do have one ask: can you send an updated quote that includes a short-term Dedicated reservation (3 months) + estimated overage rates? Procurement wants that line item to fit into our finance approval flow.

Also looping procurement (procurement@stellarapps.com) — happy to set a quick call with your team and Aditya to finalize the throughput numbers. Can you & Aditya do 11am PT tomorrow for a 20-min alignment?

Thanks —
Michael
VP Product, StellarApps
michael@stellarapps.com | +1 (646) 555-0199
